image_description: A large, dark brown bison standing on a gravel path with grass and trees in the background. The animal is facing slightly to the right, showcasing its massive shoulder hump, shaggy forequarters, and a single visible curved horn.

The visible eye is dark and small, consistent with the species.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and are largely blended into or hidden by the dense head fur.

While the legs appear sturdy, the feet/hooves are either cut off by the bottom frame edge or obscured by shadow/grass. Cloven hooves are not clearly visible for verification.
The tail is completely occluded by the animal's body angle and hind leg; it is impossible to see.
